ada.text: Good morning, everyone! I'm Ada, and I keep bees, so my errand was a round of the hamlet checking on the hives and the blossom they feed on. The orchard is humming, and the bees were out early on the dawn light. I stopped by the green, the orchard and the cottage way, and I'm happy to report a sweet season ahead. Thank you for listening!

bo.text: Um... hello. This morning I meant to practise my tune alone by the pond. But on the way, my plans changed, and I came here to listen with all of you instead. I think I like the change; a quiet song sounds better with company.
